title: WIST Label Envelope (WIST-2 §3.3)
description: A Labeler's signed statement about a subject outside its own authority, under a Label Registry name (WIST-4 §6). Self-labeling, the subject's normalization and cap, the name's registry form beyond its syntax, the clock rule over `asserted_at`, `expires_at` falling after `asserted_at`, `delta` only with a URL subject, and the key binding are WIST-2 §3.3 and WIST-1 checks the schema cannot make.

wist_version.description: Release-version spelling only. WIST-1 sections 3.1 and 7 separately require supported-major validation; minor and patch differences alone do not reject.

labeler.description: Signed Labeler identity, bound as a Catalog's `publisher` is under WIST-1 section 3.8; must equal its own Canonical Host. The pattern alone does not validate A-labels.

subject.description: A Normalized URL (WIST-1 section 2) byte-identical to its own normalization, or a Canonical Host. `url_cap_bytes` bounds its JCS octets (WIST-4 §5); the pattern alone establishes neither normalization nor the cap.

name.description: `<prefix>:<term>` from the Label Registry (WIST-4 §6): the prefix `wist` carries only the registry's own terms, every other prefix is a Canonical Host whose terms that domain defines.

value.description: Micro-units, 0 … 1 000 000; absent where the name carries no magnitude.

asserted_at.description: The instant the statement is asserted for, read exactly as an Item's `observed_at` (WIST-1 section 3.4): Gregorian calendar validation, exact fractions and offsets, seconds 00–59; the pattern alone does not establish calendar validity.

retracted.description: Present only where the Label withdraws the Labeler's earlier Label of the same name on the same subject (WIST-2 §3.3).

expires_at.description: OPTIONAL. The instant from which the Label applies nothing (WIST-2 §3.3): a Publisher timestamp under WIST-1 section 3.4's profile that MUST be later than `asserted_at`; compared to an Epoch's `sealed_at` when the Label is applied. The pattern alone establishes neither calendar validity nor the order.

delta.description: OPTIONAL, only with a Normalized URL subject: the Item ID of the publication the Label is bound to (WIST-2 §3.3); the Label applies only while the subject URL's record carries that Item (WIST-3 §7). An Item ID is SHA-256 over an Item, which carries a salted commitment and no content.
